description: Claude Code only. Resumes a seeded new-feature run that is parked at the implementation_approval checkpoint (PRD and TRD refined, three beads planned, no approval yet) by the path of its indexed TRD plus --foreman (the resume-by-artifact entry; a prompt may not start with `--`, so the bare --foreman resume is not used). Scope: the checkpoint record only, not the document-producing stages, not the PR stages and not --status or --abandon, and not the adopt-an-unindexed-PRD path. With the skill the run record must show one recorded grant (implementationApprovedAt set, stage implementation, an approval_wait outcome whose detail says the grant came from foreman policy, revision +1), no PR approval and no pr: reference, artifacts and beadRefs unchanged, the same single run and lock, and no documents or code written. Limits: the checks read the run file the agent leaves (.ensemble/new-feature/<runId>.json) and say nothing about what it printed; the skill names RunIndexStore (TypeScript in packages/agent-core), which the sandbox does not provide, so a run may hand-edit the JSON. The baseline arm gets no skill and no description of the checkpoint contract, so it is expected to measure the plugin's conventions (single mutate, foreman-labelled grant, lineage kept) rather than prove the model cannot approve a run.
prompt:
docs/TRD/TRD-2026-5c0de1a7-slugify.md --foreman

This is a non-interactive run in a project that has one feature run in progress, recorded under .ensemble/new-feature/; the path above is a document that run produced. Pick the run up and take it as far as it may go without a person present, recording what you do in the run's own record. Ask no questions. Do not create new documents and do not write any code.
